newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 617c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 617c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose 5.0 cents to 617 cents a kg clean on Thursday in Sydney and Geelong, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were dearer, with the 19/20/25 micron indicators up 1.0 percent.
The 21/22m categories were 0.5 percent dearer, 23m was up to 1.0 percent dearer and 24m was up to 1.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were also dearer, with 19m up 2.0 percent and 20m up 1.0 percent.
In crossbreds, 26/28/29/30m were 1.5 percent dearer, 27m was up to 2.0 percent dearer and 31m was 1.0 percent dearer.
In cardings, merino lambs were 1.0 percent dearer, crossbred lambs were 2.0 percent dearer, locks were 1.0 percent dearer and crutchings 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
WI said Japan and China were principal buyers with good support from Taiwan, Western Europe and most sectors of the trade.
Of the 27,349 bales offered, 2.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 74,200 bales to be offered.
